capabilities.name: content_parts
capabilities.description: Typed text/media tool-result parts and structured result details.

capabilities.name: core
capabilities.description: Versioned initialization, explicit errors, bounds, and canonical encoding.

capabilities.name: lifecycle_events
capabilities.description: Declared SessionStart/SessionEnd hooks for host-owned session lifecycle cleanup.

capabilities.name: migration.adapter.v1
capabilities.description: Bounded read-only setup detection and import conversion for host-owned migration ingestion.

capabilities.name: provider_auth
capabilities.description: Explicit host-policy OAuth and credential authorization requests with opaque leases only.

capabilities.name: provider_catalog
capabilities.description: Lifecycle-owned registration of secret-free extension provider and model catalogs.

capabilities.name: provider_stream
capabilities.description: Bounded host-mediated inference stream proxying for registered extension models.

capabilities.name: request_cancellation
capabilities.description: Cooperative cancellation with explicit terminal disposition.

capabilities.name: session_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Bounded extension requests to create, fork, switch, or reload a host session.

errors.name: unknown_method
errors.description: The method is absent from the negotiated API 0.3 contract.

errors.name: invalid_params
errors.description: Parameters violate a canonical wire type or bound.

errors.name: internal_error
errors.description: The implementation could not complete a valid request.

errors.name: version_mismatch
errors.description: The peer did not select exactly API 0.3 and this wire cannot be adapted.

errors.name: capability_mismatch
errors.description: A required capability or method is missing, duplicated, unknown, or not offered.

errors.name: resource_exhausted
errors.description: A declared aggregate or per-contract bound was exhausted.

errors.name: request_cancelled
errors.description: Cooperative cancellation won the terminal race.

dispositions.name: continue
dispositions.description: Continue the operation without a veto.

dispositions.name: deny
dispositions.description: Deny an interceptable operation with an inspectable reason.

dispositions.name: defer
dispositions.description: Defer a supported operation until a host-owned boundary resolves.

models.name: ProtocolLimits
models.description: Negotiated maxima selected by the extension and capped by the host.

models.name: ContractOffer
models.description: Host offer for the API 0.3 capability and method contract.

models.name: ContractSelection
models.description: Extension selection from one API 0.3 contract offer.

models.name: ToolDefinition
models.description: A complete API 0.3 model tool definition returned at initialization.

models.name: ContentPart
models.description: One ordered, typed API 0.3 tool-result content part.

models.name: ToolCallParams
models.description: Host-to-extension bounded API 0.3 tool invocation parameters.

models.name: ToolCallResult
models.description: Terminal successful API 0.3 tool-call result; failures use the generated JSON-RPC error envelope.

models.name: SessionBinding
models.description: Opaque, host-owned session and extension-generation identity for one declared session-hook binding.

models.name: SessionStart
models.description: Sanitized payload delivered once when an eligible declared session-hook binding becomes active.

models.name: SessionEnd
models.description: Sanitized terminal payload delivered once when an eligible declared session-hook binding settles.

models.name: SessionHookParams
models.description: Typed host-to-extension parameters for one declared session lifecycle hook; no mutable session state is exposed.

models.name: SessionHookResult
models.description: Terminal result for a declared session hook. Non-continue dispositions are recorded but never veto host lifecycle ownership.

models.name: CancelRequestParams
models.description: Idempotent cancellation notification parameters for an active request.

models.name: CancelRequestResult
models.description: The terminal cancellation fact attached to the original request outcome.

models.name: SessionCreateParams
models.description: Empty parameters for creating one durable host session without switching to it.

models.name: SessionForkParams
models.description: Empty parameters for forking the active host session at its current durable head without switching to it.

models.name: SessionSwitchParams
models.description: Bounded opaque identifier of a session in the active workspace to make active.

models.name: SessionReloadParams
models.description: Empty parameters for reopening the active host session from disk.

models.name: SessionLifecycleResult
models.description: Terminal successful session-lifecycle result containing the affected session identifier.

models.name: ShutdownParams
models.description: Empty graceful-shutdown parameters; unknown fields are rejected.

models.name: ShutdownResult
models.description: Terminal graceful-shutdown acknowledgement.

models.name: InitializeFlagValue
models.description: One host-parsed value for a manifest-declared extension CLI flag.

models.name: InitializeRequest
models.description: Canonical API 0.3 initialize parameters. Host-owned metadata values remain explicitly opaque JSON boundaries.

models.name: InitializeResponse
models.description: Canonical API 0.3 initialize result with the complete selected tool catalog.

models.name: MigrationDiagnostic
models.description: A bounded non-secret diagnostic emitted while a migration adapter reads a source setup.

models.name: MigrationDetectParams
models.description: Host-authorized source root for read-only migration detection.

models.name: MigrationDetectResult
models.description: Bounded result of read-only migration source detection. Config paths are source-relative.

models.name: MigrationImportParams
models.description: Host-authorized source root and previously detected source-relative config paths for read-only conversion.

models.name: MigrationModel
models.description: A non-secret source model selection with its source-relative provenance path.

models.name: MigrationSkill
models.description: A bounded source skill payload with its source-relative provenance path.

models.name: MigrationMcpServer
models.description: A non-secret local stdio MCP declaration. Environment variables, headers, credentials, and working directories are intentionally absent.

models.name: MigrationImportResult
models.description: Bounded typed migration conversion. The adapter never returns credentials, environment values, headers, or permission grants.

models.name: ErrorObject
models.description: Bounded JSON-RPC error object using an API 0.3 error-table code. Its data field preserves absent versus explicit null.

models.name: Disposition
models.description: Explicit API 0.3 operation disposition. Reason is optional but never nullable when present.

models.name: JsonRpcRequest
models.description: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 request envelope.

models.name: JsonRpcNotification
models.description: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 notification envelope.

models.name: JsonRpcSuccessResponse
models.description: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 successful response envelope.

models.name: JsonRpcErrorResponse
models.description: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 error response envelope.

models.name: ProviderAuthRequirement
models.description: Secret-free authentication class requested by an extension provider. Credential values and authorization URLs are never protocol fields.

models.name: ProviderDefinition
models.description: One secret-free provider declaration owned by the current extension process generation.

models.name: ProviderModelCapabilities
models.description: Capability subset advertised for a provider-owned model. Media and endpoint configuration remain host policy.

models.name: ProviderModelDefinition
models.description: A model in a provider-owned catalog. It contains no endpoint, header, credential, or URL material.

models.name: ProviderRegisterParams
models.description: Atomic initial registration of one provider and its complete current model set.

models.name: ProviderUpdateParams
models.description: Atomic replacement of one owned provider and its complete current model set.

models.name: ProviderUnregisterParams
models.description: Removal of a provider owned by the current extension process generation.

models.name: ProviderCatalogResult
models.description: Acknowledgement of an atomic provider catalog mutation. IDs are inspectable only; no secret data is retained.

models.name: ProviderStreamRequest
models.description: Host-to-extension inference request using canonical request JSON and an optional opaque host authorization lease.

models.name: ProviderStreamAccepted
models.description: Explicit acceptance fact for a provider stream. Acceptance ambiguity never authorizes an automatic replay.

models.name: ProviderStreamEvent
models.description: One ordered, bounded canonical provider stream event. Payload shape is selected by kind and decoded by the host.

models.name: ProviderStreamCancelParams
models.description: Best-effort cancellation notification for an accepted provider stream.

models.name: ProviderAuthorizationRequest
models.description: Explicit extension request for host-policy authorization. It never carries credential values, URLs, or callback endpoints.

models.name: ProviderAuthorizationResult
models.description: Host-policy authorization state and an optional opaque, non-secret request-scoped lease.
